translation: One should use Tiaozhong Yiqi Tang (Regulate the Center and Boost Qi Decoction) with the addition of five fen of Wu Zhuyu (Evodia); use it according to the amount of qi. (Piwet Lun, Discussion of the Spleen and Stomach.) When this occurs in summer, it is a sign of great heat; use Huanglian (Coptis), Huangbai (Phellodendron), and Zhimu (Anemarrhena) in equal parts, washed in wine and stir-fried, ground into powder, mixed with plain water into pills; take one to two hundred pills each time on an empty stomach with plain water, then press them down with fine food, not allowing them to remain in the stomach, until they reach the lower origin, in order to drain the pathogenic factor of the Chong vessel. For this disease, treat according to the cold, heat, warmth, and coolness of the four seasons.
